channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, AI, Tech & Research, Asia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, AI, Tech & Research, Asia, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 1 new AI, Tech & Research residency - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• TOKAS Research Residency Program 2027
    https://www.tokyoartsandspace.jp/en/archive/application/2026/20260430-321.html
    Tokyo Arts and Space (TOKAS) · deadline Closed 16 Jun 2026 · Fully funded: round-trip economy airfare, accommodation in a single 25 sqm room at TOKAS Residency (49 sqm twin for duos), per-diem living expenses, plus assistance for research and public relations. No application fee.
